in_sanskrit.name: कालिवंश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The lineage or dynasty of Goddess Kali. Kali is the goddess of time, change, creation, and destruction. She is the consort of Lord Shiva and is known for her fierce form that removes all obstacles.

in_hindi.name: कालिवंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: कालिके से उत्पन्न वंश (The lineage born from Goddess Kali)

in_tamil.name: காலிவாங்ச்
in_tamil.long_meaning: காலியின் வாங்சம் (The lineage of Goddess Kali)

in_telugu.name: కాలివాంశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: కాలియేశ్ వాంశ్ (The lineage of Goddess Kali)

in_marathi.name: Kalivansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of Kali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kalivansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who belongs to the lineage of Goddess Kali, the goddess of time, change, and destruction.

in_bengali.name: Kalivansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Descendant of Kali
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kalivansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who belongs to the lineage of Goddess Kali, the goddess of time, change, and destruction.
